description: I am a Software Engineering student focused on AI, computer vision, and embedded/flight systems. Experienced in TEKNOFEST, I build end-to-end solutions using YOLO, TensorRT on NVIDIA Jetson, and STM32 hardware integration. I love turning complex ideas into working prototypes under pressure. Looking for motivated teammates in frontend/UI, data science, or backend/CAD to build an impactful project together for this NASA challenge!
